details: The U.S. Senate Majority Leader has advanced the "Clarity Act," a significant bill aiming to establish a comprehensive federal regulatory framework for cryptocurrencies. The bill, which defines digital tokens and clarifies regulatory oversight, is slated for a procedural vote in mid-September after the August recess. This move is seen as a win for the crypto industry and the Trump administration, despite ongoing Democratic opposition regarding ethics concerns and bank lobbying against stablecoin yield provisions.
title: US Senate Advances Landmark Crypto Bill Amid Debate

details: Bitcoin saw gains, briefly topping $65,000, after weaker-than-expected U.S. jobs data for July. The economy reportedly lost 23,000 jobs, against forecasts for an 80,000 gain, pushing the unemployment rate down to 4.1%. This data has significantly reduced expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in September, generally benefiting risk assets, including cryptocurrencies, by making them more attractive to investors.
title: Bitcoin Rises as Weak US Jobs Data Cools Fed Rate Hike Expectations

details: A significant security breach involving Coldcard hardware wallets, a popular "cold storage" solution, has resulted in the theft of over $100 million in Bitcoin. The attack exploited a software flaw, impacting thousands of wallets and prompting urgent warnings for users to update their devices or take them offline. This incident highlights persistent security risks and has reignited debate over the safety of self-custody in the crypto sector.
title: Coldcard Hardware Wallet Suffers $100M+ Bitcoin Hack

details: South Africa's National Treasury and the South African Reserve Bank (SARB) have released a draft of new guidelines for cross-border cryptocurrency transactions. The proposed framework aims to combat illicit financial flows and enhance oversight by requiring all offshore crypto payments to be declared and approved by SARB's FinSurv. While intended to provide clarity, these stricter regulations could introduce new hurdles for crypto businesses and users in the region.
title: South Africa Proposes Tighter Cross-Border Crypto Regulations

details: Institutional investors, including hedge funds and asset managers, are increasingly becoming the dominant force in cryptocurrency markets, gradually supplanting retail traders. Data indicates that institutional players accounted for 72% of spot trading volume on Wintermute's OTC desk in the first half of 2026, a notable rise from the previous year. This shift suggests a maturing market with greater institutional capital inflow, potentially leading to more stability but also less retail-driven volatility.
title: Wall Street Institutions Increase Dominance in Crypto Markets

details: Ripple's XRP Ledger (XRPL) is set to undergo a confidential transfer upgrade, a development viewed favorably for XRP. This upgrade is designed to address institutional concerns regarding data privacy, aiming to enhance XRPL's competitiveness for tokenizing real-world assets (RWAs) and facilitating sensitive financial settlements. Successful implementation could significantly boost the ledger's utility and demand for its native asset.
title: Ripple's XRPL Plans Confidential Transfer Upgrade for Institutions

details: Mastercard has finalized its acquisition of BVNK, a digital asset infrastructure provider, as part of its strategy to integrate traditional payment networks with stablecoin and blockchain-based payment systems. BVNK's technology enables the seamless movement, management, and conversion of both fiat and digital currencies. This acquisition is expected to help financial institutions and enterprises scale the use of stablecoin payments, fostering greater interoperability between traditional and digital finance.
title: Mastercard Acquires BVNK to Enhance Stablecoin Payment Infrastructure
